Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 code violation counts, keeping zero-count tracts via a left join and ordering violations descending with tract name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_574745' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(c.code_violations, 0) AS code_violations,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY code_violations DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
